text:
sahil: Quick preflight — we need 8 A100 nodes for sprint load tests (2024-04-03 -> 04-05). Anyone seen vendor availability or quota gaps? cc @maria @jen
maria: short answer: vendor reported 6 available in us-west1 but 2 are on backorder. Procurement pinged them yesterday. :thinking:
jen: FYI I opened the quota PR (#4218) to bump project GPU quota; blocking e2e. Still awaiting cloud team approval.
alicia-procurement: PO submitted last night. Vendor ACKed but shipment window 3–5 business days. They said priority lane might shave a day if we pay expedite. :money_with_wings:
ops-oncall: We can carve 4 nodes from demo-pool overnight Apr 2-4; that'll cover smoke + first round. Will that help?
sahil: That helps a lot. If we take 4 from demo, we still need 4 more. Can procurement confirm expedite cost? Also need the exact quota change ID for the PR.
alicia-procurement: Expedite quote = +$2,600, vendor ref VN-33211. Confirmed PO includes expedite option if you reply here OK. Quota change in PR description: billing-project/gpu-quota#inc-8.
jen: adding the quota diff here for ops: ```gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-inference | grep -A2 GPUs``` Use that to validate after approval.
dev-demo: happy to hand over slice; will need tag change on tfvars. @maria can you approve terraform bump? :+1:
maria: I'll approve the tfvars PR shortly. One ask — can we stagger the onboarding so not all nodes hit preemptible pools at once? Keep one on dedicated.
sahil: Good call. Plan: borrow 4 from demo (one dedicated), procurement proceeds with expedite for remaining 4. Jen—will you follow up on quota approval? Alicia—please proceed once we say OK on expedite.
jen: On it, pinging cloud-ops for quota approval now. (I'll paste their response here.)
alicia-procurement: Hold — vendor just replied, expedite won't buy us extra GPUs, only faster shipment. They can release 2 more from an internal pool if we sign NDAs. I'm getting legal on it.
sahil: rough plan sounds feasible. If legal OK, we proceed. If not, we fallback to 2 demo + 6 staggered across days. Thanks all.
ops-oncall: noted — will reserve demo slice and annotate maintenance window Apr2 22:00-04:00 UTC.
jen: cloud-ops approved quota bump pending billing confirmation. Will paste official ticket once they ack.
maria: thanks team. I'll queue terraform PR merge once quota ticket exists. :rocket:
